subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing how translation choices can affect meaning, tone, and interpretation of a work
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two different English translations of the same short foreign-language passage and notices differences
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a translation choice to the shift in tone or meaning it creates
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a specific translation choice affects a reader's interpretation of a passage

misconception_flags: assumes a translated text is identical in every respect to its original-language version

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
